last.verdict: Record quarter and above-forecast outlook, but growth looks set to slow sharply.

reasons.label: Growth slowing
reasons.text: December revenue guide of $8.6B implies under 5% growth after 22% last quarter.

reasons.label: China share to drop
reasons.text: China was 35% of sales; management expects a meaningfully lower share in December.

reasons.label: Supply shortages cap sales
reasons.text: CFO said the outlook would have been higher without parts shortages; shipments slip to March.

story: Lam's sales growth sped up through 2026 (9%, then 15%, then 22% by September), and July's guidance sent the stock up sharply. Expectations became very high, so a beat with slower guidance now triggered a sell-off.
